service.en: Amend a domestic worker's work contract
service.ar: تعديل عقد عمل عامل مساعدة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کے ورک کنٹریکٹ میں ترمیم

about: An employer amends the data in a domestic worker's work contract and receives the amended contract.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Attested contract, document or receipt from the issuing entity
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
